entities.name: PMID:25452595
observations: 2015 Clinical Infectious Diseases study used whole-genome sequencing and epidemiology to assess Mycobacterium abscessus transmission in pediatric cystic fibrosis patients.

entities.name: Limited M. abscessus transmission
observations: WGS of 27 isolates from 20 patients found isolates from 16 patients at least 34 SNPs apart and therefore unrelated.

A sibling pair with intense contact had isolates at most 17 SNPs apart, supporting likely transmission; another pair at most 24 SNPs apart lacked an apparent epidemiological link, so hospital cross-transmission was not established for the cohort generally.
